whyHire.title: Fewer interviews. Stronger hires.
whyHire.description: Generic recruiters flood your inbox with 200 CVs. We do the opposite. Fewer candidates, sharper screening, picked by people who can read code.

roles.title: Who we recruit
roles.description: Technical roles across web, mobile, and infrastructure. We staff builders, not resume matchers.

cards.title: Frontend engineers
cards.description: React, Vue, TypeScript. Builders who care about UX, not just framework points.

cards.title: Full stack engineers
cards.description: Architects who own both sides. Any stack: JS, Python, Go, PHP.

cards.title: Backend engineers
cards.description: Node, Go, PHP. Engineers who ship and scale, not just write services.

cards.title: Mobile developers
cards.description: iOS, Android, React Native. Proven shipping history, not side projects.

cards.title: DevOps and infrastructure
cards.description: Reliability minded engineers who own pipelines, observability, and incidents.

cards.title: Analysts
cards.description: System and business analysts who translate product needs into engineering specs.

process.title: How a hire happens, step by step
process.description: Five stages, transparent at every step. You stay in control. We handle the work.

cards.title: Discovery and hiring brief
cards.description: We dig into the role, the team, and what success looks like. Not just the stack. That clarity drives every screen.

cards.title: Targeted sourcing
cards.description: We pull from our network and headhunt directly. The rarer the profile, the more this matters.

cards.title: Screening and shortlist
cards.description: Every candidate is calibrated, screened, and aligned before they reach you. You only meet the ones we would hire ourselves.

cards.title: Interview support and offer
cards.description: We advise on interview structure, read signals with you, and negotiate the offer so it lands.

cards.title: Onboarding and probation
cards.description: We stay involved past the start date. If something wobbles in month one, we are on it.

team.description: Two people own your search from first brief to first day on the job. You will talk to the same humans the whole way. No account manager middle layer.

items.question: Do you only work with startups?
items.answer: No. We hire for startups, SMBs, product teams, and custom software firms. Anywhere technical hiring is hard, we can help.

items.question: Is this only for developers?
items.answer: Developers, DevOps, mobile, analysts, architects. If the role is technical, it is in scope.

items.question: Can you find rare or niche profiles?
items.answer: That is our edge. The rarer the role, the more our network and targeted headhunting pay off. The Novakid search is a typical example.

items.question: Who runs the technical interviews?
items.answer: You do. We handle sourcing, screening, and coordination. Your team owns the technical depth call. If you need help structuring interviews, we will advise.
